label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: After my first click on a product link the page tree collapsed to only the live chat frame for two turns, so nothing could be read or targeted until I pressed Escape
Product links appear several times with the same name, and the first one (nth 0) could not be clicked; only the second worked, and only after a slow press. An empty link before it has no name at all

Two buttons are both named Add to cart (a quick bar and the main one), so I could not tell which was which. The cart count still said 0 right after adding, with no clear message that the item was added
A recommendations popup with no named close control appeared after adding and covered the cart button, which blocked my click until I pressed Escape. The cart drawer did not open by itself

The checkbox for package protection ($3.50) has no accessible name, so I could not tell what it does or whether it is ticked. Also the Remove button name in the bag contains raw code text (") and a trailing dash
